translations./garage/heading: Bring the Valley Relay Back Online
translations./garage/brief: The valley relay is dark. RO-1 must recover its power module; that will also wake the east-depot forklifts, so it must judge the blind crossing before it commits.
translations./prediction/heading: What evidence should decide when RO-1 enters the blind crossing?
translations./prediction/hint: Choose the evidence you expect to matter. After the run, test that idea against the recorded encounter.
translations./prediction/choices/0/text: The forklift’s current distance from the intersection
translations./prediction/choices/0/feedback: Current distance cannot say whether both paths will occupy the crossing together. The same distance with another speed or direction produces another outcome.
translations./prediction/choices/1/text: Projected arrival overlap from position, direction, and speed
translations./prediction/choices/1/feedback: This run supports that claim: RO-1 projects the moving track forward, then checks when it overlaps its own path.
translations./prediction/choices/2/text: Whether the static map marks the corridor permanently occupied
translations./prediction/choices/2/feedback: A static map fits racks and walls. A forklift moves, so permanent occupancy cannot say when the corridor becomes safe.
translations./running/heading: Send the Signal · Bring the Valley Back Online
translations./running/normal_line: RO-1: Autonomously recovering power, observing the crossing, and starting the relay.
translations./running/detected_line: RO-1: Forklift track established. Predicting time conflict at the crossing.
translations./running/goal_lines/0: RO-1: The relay is still dark. Planning a route to the power module.
translations./running/goal_lines/1: RO-1: Power module secured. Waking the east-depot equipment.
translations./running/goal_lines/2: RO-1: Depot traffic is active. Moving to the blind observation point.
translations./running/goal_lines/3: RO-1: Observation complete. I will enter only after the predicted path clears.
translations./debrief/success_summary: RO-1 observed the forklift, predicted the conflict, waited for a safe opening, and restored the valley signal.
